thread:
incident-bot: PAGER -> private-cluster-nyc-2: GPU queue length > 1200 (15m), autoscaler failing to create nodes. Symptoms: node bootstrap timeouts, imagepull backoffs. Severity: P1. Oncall: @alice (primary). Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-warmup>
alice (oncall): ack, taking it. paging now. I'll collect logs and escalate if autoscaler still failing after 5m. :phone:
raj (eng-sre): I'm on autoscaler logs. Seeing repeated errors: `FailedCreate: quotaExceeded` followed by `node start timeout` for several AZs. Full snippet:
```
E0412 12:47:02 autoscaler.go:421] scale-up failed: compute.instances.insert: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. project 12345
E0412 12:47:03 kubelet  error: image pull rate limit: backoff  BackOff: Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/redwood/pool-image:latest"
```
marina (eng-runtime): Customer workload is heavy seq-len 2k bursts, we saw sustained ~850 req/s. Autoscaler config has maxNodes=120, current=118 — so it's near limit. If quota is the issue the controller can't create more. We should consider warm pool or redirect.
tom (eng-platform): I can bump maxNodes to 160 temporarily in the pool config but if quota is truly exceeded that won't help. What GCE quotas do we have? @anya can you confirm region quotas and any manual caps?
anya (infra): Checking quotas now. Project GPU quota for us-east4 (NYC) is at 128 (includes reserved). Looks like two other teams consuming left ~6 available. That explains `quotaExceeded`. We can request quota bump but that takes time. Short term: I can spin up smaller instances with fewer GPUs (e.g., 1xA100 -> 1xA10x) in a separate pool to handle lightweight requests. Need approval to create new instance template.
sam (solutions): Heads-up — acme-corp (customer) is in-flight on private cluster; they're hitting 503s. Kevin, can you confirm customer impact and SLA?
kevin (cust-success): Confirmed — acme reported timeouts to their integration at 12:46. They're seeing ~20% error rate on text-gen endpoints. They flagged it as high priority. Customer expects in-region failover, not cross-region. We're updating them every 10m.
alice (oncall): Ok plan: 1) Try manual warm pool creation with smaller-GPU instances in same VPC; 2) Re-route low-latency but high-cost traffic to hosted fallback for acme (with their consent); 3) Continue quota request in parallel. Who owns each? Tom infra for warm-pool, Marina to toggle fallback policy, Kevin to coordinate with customer.
tom (eng-platform): I'll create a new node pool now: `gcloud compute instance-templates create redwood-warm-a10 --custom-cpu=8 --custom-memory=52GB --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10,count=1` then `gcloud container clusters resize private-nyc-2 --node-pool=redwood-warm-a10 --num-nodes=8`.
raj (eng-sre): Before that, watch autoscaler events: `kubectl -n redwood get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50` shows many `FailedCreate` events. Also some pods stuck Pending: `Insufficient gpu` and `ImagePullBackOff` for the pool image due to rate-limits. Suggest pulling image to a mirror in customer VPC registry.
marina (eng-runtime): I'll start adjusting routing policies on the control-plane: set `fallback_policy` for acme-corp route to `hosted:priority=high` for 10m window. That will send new requests to hosted region while we drain queue. Also lowering model selection to `redwood-small-v2` for non-critical flows to reduce GPU time.
deploy-bot: build/4378 deployed redwood-warm-a10-template -> success
tom (eng-platform): warm pool boot started. Issues: some nodes failing `docker pull` with `429 Too Many Requests`. I'm asking infra to mirror image to customer's private registry.
anya (infra): Mirroring images now to `gcr.private.acme/redwood/pool-image:mirror-2987`. Running `gcloud auth configure-docker` then `docker pull`/`docker push` scripts.
alice (oncall): acme contacted us asking for ETA. Kevin, can you give them a short note: "we're provisioning fallback capacity and routing some traffic to hosted. Expect partial relief within ~12 minutes" — send now.
kevin (cust-success): Sent: "We're provisioning temporary nodes and enabling hosted fallback; we expect error rate to drop within ~15 minutes. Will update in 10." They replied: "Appreciate the quick response" :pray:
raj (eng-sre): Warm pool nodes are up but a few still `NotReady` due to driver install failures. `kubectl describe node` shows `nvidia-drivers` failed to install on 2/8 nodes. I'm running `sudo /usr/local/bin/install-nvidia.sh` as a workaround.
marina (eng-runtime): Starting route flip now for acme-corp: `PATCH /routes/acme-corp {"fallback":"hosted","ttl":600}` — done. New traffic to hosted should be visible in metrics.
alice (oncall): Monitoring metrics -> private cluster queue length dropped from 1250 to 700 in last 6m. Error rate for acme from 20% to 8%. Keep monitoring. If queue > 1000 after 20m we escalate to infra on-call for emergency quota bump.
tom (eng-platform): Confirm nodes now 8 healthy, 6 ready. One more driver install in progress. If driver failure persists we'll re-image those nodes which takes ~4m.
raj (eng-sre): Also rotating through backlog prioritization: marking customer-critical pods with `priorityClass=high` to drain high-priority requests first. Applied patch.
marina (eng-runtime): Lowered model instance size for batch jobs; estimates token/sec per GPU reduced ~30% but latency improved for p95.
alice (oncall): Good. Action items:
- tom: follow-up re: node driver and re-image failures (in progress)
- anya: continue quota request, open ticket to GCE with urgency
- marina: keep fallback enabled for acme and monitor cost impact
- raj: confirm all pending pods schedule and no new imagepull issues
- kevin/sam: keep customer updated every 10m
I'll keep this thread as the oncall handoff. If anyone else joins please @alice.
kevin (cust-success): Customer updated. They're okay with hosted fallback for now.
deploy-bot: image-mirror job 789 succeeded -> mirrored tag mirror-2987
tom (eng-platform): re-image done on two nodes; drivers installed. All 8 nodes Ready. Backlog draining faster.
raj (eng-sre): Final check: queue down to 280, acme error rate ~1.5%. No new `FailedCreate` events after mirror/driver fixes. I'll keep monitoring dashboards for 30m.
alice (oncall): marking incident as "mitigating". We'll leave fallback in place 30m then re-evaluate. Postmortem owner: raj. Initial notes to postmortem tracker: root cause = region GPU quota exhaustion combined with image-pull rate limits and driver-install failures delaying warm pool capacity.
marina (eng-runtime): Suggested long-term mitigations: pre-warm small-GPU pool for private clusters, mirror pool images to customer registries on provisioning, automated fallback toggles per-customer when queue > threshold.
kevin (cust-success): Customer wants a post-incident call tomorrow. I'll coordinate.
alice (oncall): Thanks all. I'll hand this off to second-shift in 25m unless we need more action. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 2987654321 status updated -> MITIGATING. Link: <https://redwood.incidents/2987654321>
